name: spokesperson-brief
title: Internal spokesperson brief
for_each: select id,code from inquiries order by code

sections.title: Journalist
sections.sql: select c.name,c.organisation,c.status from contacts c join inquiries i on i.contact_id=c.id where i.id=$1

sections.title: Statement readiness
sections.sql: select r.code,r.title,r.revision,r.readiness,r.embargo_until from release_calendar r join releases x on x.code=r.code join inquiries i on i.release_id=x.id where i.id=$1
sections.note: Internal only. Statement text is withheld here. Use the checked draft command after approval and embargo review.

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select f.code,f.owner,f.task,f.due_at,f.completed_at,f.outcome from followups f where f.inquiry_id=$1 order by f.due_at

name: release-approval
title: Internal release approval record
for_each: select id,code from releases order by code

sections.title: Current decision
sections.note: Approval applies only to the current revision. This report grants no permission to publish.

sections.title: Version history
sections.sql: select revision,title,author,embargo_until,created_at from release_versions where release_id=$1 order by revision

name: campaign-review
title: Internal campaign review
for_each: select id,code from campaigns order by code

sections.title: Purpose
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,objective,audience from campaigns where id=$1

sections.title: Requests
sections.sql: select code,subject,owner,deadline,status,outcome from inquiries where campaign_id=$1 order by deadline

sections.title: Statements
sections.sql: select code,title,revision,author,approved_by,embargo_until from releases where campaign_id=$1 order by code
